invariants.expression: (name == null && result == -1) || (name != null && result == x + name.length())
invariants.rationale: The method returns -1 if name is null, otherwise returns x plus the length of name.

meta.value: Invariant connecting input parameters to the result

invariants.rationale: The method can only return -1 or x plus the positive length of name, so result >= -1.
Since name.length() > 0 if name is not null, result = x + name.length() > x.

meta.value: If name is not null, result is greater than x
